texts.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们一定已经知道了，我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]致力于研究并保存宇宙中的所有生命形式。我们已经研究了你们的种群，并认为[Root.GetName]最多只能维持几个世纪。为确保极端情况下[Root.GetSpeciesName]的存续，我们希望贵帝国能有一部分人口，加入我们的濒危种群保护区。我们会专门创建一片保护区，完全复制你们种群的自然生存环境，其所有居民也会获得全面的照顾与保护，你也不用担心他们的安危。

那么，你觉得怎么样？我们会致力保存并保护你们的种群。那你是否愿意为这份事业做出自己的贡献呢？
texts.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unlikely to last for more than a few centuries at best. To ensure the continuation of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species should the worst befall your empire, we would like to acquire a part of your population for our Endangered Species Preserve. We will construct a special reservation that perfectly mirrors the natural habitat of your species, and its population will be well taken care of and protected from all harm, so you need not worry on their behalf.

So, what do you say? Will you contribute to our preserve and safeguard the future of your species?

label.en: Very well, you will have your contribution.

tooltips.zh: 一组[Root.GetSpeciesName]人口将从你的帝国移除。
tooltips.en: A group of [Root.GetSpeciesName] Pops will be taken from your empire.

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]会很满意的，也许还会在未来对我们加以青睐。
tooltips.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be pleased, and may show us favor in the future.

label.zh: 我们是绝不会将自己的人民交到外星人手中的！
label.en: We will never surrender our population to alien hands!
Our people are not for sale, [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName].

label.zh: 不，我们不会抛弃我们的人们。
